scope: ResolveQueue strict ABI, SDK full-slot driver, automatic atomic merge/consume/cancel checks and input UID closure; Ftq top-level protocol migration remains required

seed1.selection: All original ResolveQueue tests, resolve_transactions/schema controls, cycle_sampling and all original CommitQueue tests

original_program_preservation.boundary: These7 original bodies formerly ended with accepted reports held behind ready0. Only after all original assertions they now explicitly request drain_all; finish/fixture never invent ready. Original report streams,180-iteration random ownership,512 slot/source vectors, wrap/toggle and overflow counterexamples are not deleted or shortened.

implementation: ResolveInput validates/copies the complete simultaneous3-backend+IFU vector and semantic reset/ready/redirect/enqueue controls before any side effect. The SDK SyncDriver owns all47 non-clock inputs; independent schema checks all60 outputs and clock width/direction. No fake enqueue-pointer flag is supplied.

Each planned slot/source has an environment(epoch, slot, source)UID. Atomic before/after snapshots compare actual inputs, full identity/startPc, branch payload/order and the real8-bit valid mask. Returned data/PC/index never select the input UID.

Reference entry ownership/startPc comes from the first input ancestor under RQ-001/003. Same-entry reports append in source priority and suppress training during merge; unrelated new reports and an old ready completion can occur in the same slot.

Backend filter, pre-edge global capacity rejection and branch-capacity rejection are explicit non-accepted terminals. IFU bypasses only the backend semantic filter, not finite capacity. Redirect grace, overwrite-by-pointer-value, normal completion and asynchronous reset cancellation keep distinct terminal sets.

Bounded finish preserves declared consumer readiness; it cannot raise ready, flush or reset to erase debt. Exact idle tail checks, cancellation-after-edge, closed observers, wrong input, missing/spurious output, changed identity/payload/mask and swallowed public/reference errors cannot pass clean finish.
